subtitle: A good guitar strap is essential for comfortable standing play. From basic nylon to premium leather, discover how to choose the perfect strap for your instrument and playing style.

introduction.title: Why Your Strap Choice Matters
introduction.text: Comfort and style for standing performance. Your guitar strap affects weight distribution, playing position, mobility, and stamina during standing play.

columns.title: Comfort & Ergonomics
columns.text: Weight Distribution: Reduces shoulder and neck strain. Playing Position: Maintains consistent guitar height. Mobility: Allows free movement during performance. Stamina: Enables longer playing sessions.

columns.title: Performance Benefits
columns.text: Security: Prevents drops and accidents. Consistency: Maintains muscle memory positions. Confidence: Focus on playing, not holding the guitar. Stage Presence: Enables dynamic performance.

cards.title: Leather Straps
cards.description: Premium leather, 2-4 inches wide. Excellent comfort with very high durability. Ages beautifully with a professional look and comfortable padding.

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Professional players, heavy guitars, stage performance

cards.title: Nylon/Poly Straps
cards.description: Synthetic fabric, 2-3 inches wide. Good comfort with high durability. Lightweight and easy to clean with a variety of colors and moisture resistance.

cards.title: Neoprene Straps
cards.description: Wetsuit material, 2-4 inches wide. Excellent comfort with high durability. Superior padding with non-slip surface, sweat resistant and lightweight.

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Long practice sessions, heavy instruments, active players

cards.title: Vintage Cloth
cards.description: Woven fabric, 2-3 inches wide. Moderate comfort and durability. Classic look with vintage aesthetic, lightweight and breathable.

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Vintage instruments, lighter guitars, style preference

cards.title: Height Guidelines
items: Classical Position: Guitar body at chest level
Standard Rock: Guitar at waist to upper hip
Low Slung: Guitar at hip level or below
Match Sitting: Same height as when seated

cards.title: Adjustment Tips
items: Test with both rhythm and lead playing

cards.title: Screw-in Locks
cards.description: Replace existing strap pins with locking mechanisms.

cards.title: Clip-on Locks
cards.description: Attach to existing strap pins without modification.

cards.title: Jimi Hendrix
cards.description: Psychedelic patterned cloth strap. Iconic colorful patterns that became part of his visual identity.

cards.title: Slash
cards.description: Black leather strap with studs. Wide leather strap matching his rock aesthetic.

cards.title: John Mayer
cards.description: Premium leather with vintage styling. High-quality leather straps from various boutique makers.

cards.title: Keith Richards
cards.description: Simple black leather. Classic, no-nonsense leather strap for decades.

cards.title: Consider Your Guitar
items: Weight: Heavy guitars need wider straps
Body shape: Balance and comfort factors
Finish: Avoid strap materials that mark
Value: Match strap quality to instrument

cards.title: Playing Style Factors
items: Activity level: Active players need secure straps
Session length: Comfort for long practices

cards.title: Leather Care
items: Store properly when not in use
